facts.business: Crown Lifters Limited is engaged in providing crane rental and lifting solutions, recognizing revenue from contracts over time using the percentage-of-completion method.
key_risks: Revenue recognition involves significant management judgment in estimating total contract revenue and costs, determining stage of completion, assessing contract modifications and variable consideration, and evaluating recoverability of costs.
facts.related_party_note: Directors Mr. Karim Kamruddin Jaria and Mr. Nizar Nooruddin Rajwani are cousin brothers. Mrs. Natasha Nizar Rajwani is the wife of Mr. Nizar Nooruddin Rajwani.
